_comment: State landlord-law friendliness for the market-selection gate (Grant×Pace source). Tiers: friendly | neutral | caution | avoid. 'avoid' blocks expansion; 'caution' warns (trending unfriendly). This is a screening heuristic, not legal advice — verify current statute before entering a market. Default for unlisted states = neutral.

OR.note: statewide rent control + just-cause eviction (SB 608); strongly tenant-favorable

WA.note: just-cause eviction statewide, long notice periods, local rent-stabilization moves

CA.note: statewide rent cap + just-cause (AB 1482); slow, costly evictions

NY.note: HSTPA 2019 rent regulation + long eviction timelines; very tenant-favorable

NJ.note: local rent control common, slow eviction courts, strong tenant protections

MD.note: tenant-favorable trend; local rent control (Montgomery/PG), longer eviction process

CO.note: turning unfriendly — recent eviction-protection + for-cause legislation; watch closely

MN.note: Minneapolis/St. Paul rent-control measures; statewide neutral but trending

IL.note: Chicago tenant ordinances are strict; statewide preemption of rent control under pressure

VA.note: landlord-favorable, fast unlawful-detainer process — first LOT market (Charlottesville)

FL.note: landlord-favorable, no state rent control, fast eviction — second LOT market (Miami-Dade)

TX.note: landlord-favorable, fast eviction, no state income tax

IN.note: landlord-favorable, statewide preemption of rent control
